Irreducibility in Gaussian Quantum Markov Semigroups
events.description: Gaussian Quantum Markov Semigroups (GQMSs) constitute the class of all Markovian evolutions of bosonic systems that map quantum Gaussian states into quantum Gaussian states. They first appeared in the physics literature in the study of reduced evolutions of bosonic systems governed by quadratic Hamiltonians and interacting linearly with bosonic fields.
